subject: Post-demo buying committee recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Chris Dalton <chris.dalton@finapps.com>, Lisa Turner <lisa.turner@finapps.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@finapps.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo buying committee recap & next steps

Hi Chris / Lisa —

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and appreciate the buying committee pulling together. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so everyone has alignment: 

What we covered
- Live demo of Redwood inference runtime, batching/kv caching, and the Dedicated offering for predictable throughput.
- Performance callouts: 95th perc latency targets, typical token cost estimates for your Summarization workload.
- Integration touchpoints: API keys, VPC peering option for Private, and SSO for console access.

Decision criteria we heard
- Cost per million tokens vs current vendor
- SOC2 + dataprotection controls and DPA
- Ability to pin model versions and predictable SLA for peak month
- Support for private deployment (VPC) and KMS integration

Stakeholder map (as we understand it)
- Economic buyer: Lisa Turner, CFO (final sign-off on spend)
- Technical evaluation: Chris Dalton (Dir. of ML) and Sanjay Patel (Legal) for security reviews
- Procurement: procurement@finapps.com for PO and SOW process

Proposed next steps
1) Chris — can you confirm the decision timeline and the economic buyer? You mentioned early August as a target.
2) We will share: (a) short recap doc, (b) SOC2 summary and DPA template, (c) SOW template for procurement to review.
3) Set a 30-min call next week with Procurement + Legal to discuss contracting cadence and any required redlines.
4) If helpful, we can scope a 2-week POC on Dedicated capacity to validate latency and cost.

Attachments: finapps-demo-recording.mp4 (recording), buying-committee-recap.pdf (one-pager)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the items above and some proposed meeting slots for next week.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Make inference predictable and economical

Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 09:10:35 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo buying committee recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — great demo and clear recap. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Timeline: We are targeting a vendor decision by Aug 2. That gives Procurement ~3 weeks to review SOW and pricing.
- Economic buyer: Confirmed — Lisa Turner (CFO) will sign off on final spend.
- Security/legal: Sanjay Patel (cc'd) will run the SOC2/DPA review. He'll need SOC2 Type II report and the DPA; if you have a one-pager on data flows that would help.
- Procurement: We handle SOW + PO through procurement@finapps.com. Procurement will likely request our standard indemnity language; we can share redlines during the procurement call.

I attached our procurement checklist to show typical gating items.

Procurement checklist: procurement-checklist.xlsx

Happy to join the procurement/legal call next Tue or Wed AM PT.

Regards,
Chris
Dir. of ML, FinApps
chris.dalton@finapps.com | (650) 555-3344
